body:
Tested locally on Linux, it works as expected.

One consequence of this change is that using `timeout` to run the editor will no longer result in a recovery dialog the next time you open the project, as it sends `SIGTERM` by default. This will still happen if you use `timeout --signal KILL` though, as `SIGKILL` prevents running Godot's normal shutdown code (and therefore the lines added by this PR). I think this makes sense.
